technique_name: Explain why it is important to interview job candidates in person.
description: In-person interviews are important in the job hiring process because they provide a more comprehensive assessment of a candidate’s qualifications and personality. During an in-person interview, employers can evaluate body language, communication skills, and other intangible qualities that may get lost over video or phone calls.
